name: Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations
description: The Ravnican Agency of Magicological Investigations is a force of detectives and investigators on Ravnica, founded and led by the archon Ezrim, set up to investigate crimes without guild bias.

bio.text: After the invasion Ezrim transformed his truth cult into the Agency, recruiting Azorius associates such as Alquist Proft and members of all ten guilds.
